text:
alex (eng-release): Heads-up — aiming to roll the "garden-path" runtime tweak to hosted prod today. Target window 18:00-19:00 PT. Can @june confirm deploy owner?

june (deploy-owner): I'm on. I can own kickoff at 18:05 PT. Who's pushing the image and running the traffic shift?

alex (eng-release): It's a small config + runtime change (kv-cache TTL + quantize flag). I'll push a canary image tag `garden-path-v2.0-canary`. Plan to seed at 0.5% first.

ravi (oncall): Oncall here. What’s the explicit rollback plan and smoke checklist? Please add me to pager if errors spike > threshold.

sam (qa): QA smoke procedure: 1) check /health and readiness, 2) p95 latency < 350ms, 3) token-level errors < 0.1%, 4) run 10 golden prompts for output sanity. We'll confirm each stage before advancing.

alex (eng-release): Ramp schedule I propose: 0.5% for 10m -> 2% for 15m -> 10% for 20m -> 30% for 30m -> 75% hold then full after green. Cohort order: internal-beta (50 flagged users) -> EU + NA low-velocity buckets. Exclude enterprise customers and Dedicated clusters (they're pinned to v1).

june (deploy-owner): Agree. I'll run the release script and trigger @deploy-bot. We will manual-hold between stages.

deploy-bot: Command queued: `start-traffic-shift --tag garden-path-v2.0-canary --stages [0.5,2,10,30,75] --hold_between_stages` :rocket:

alex (eng-release): Rollback quick commands: `./ops/run_rollback.sh --tag garden-path-v2.0-canary` or `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=<prev>`; note auto-fallback exists to garden-path-v1 on surge of 5xxs.

sam (qa): Logs/metrics to watch: `tcp:proxy error rate`, `kv_cache_miss` spikes, model tokenization errors. I’ll tail with: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -c runtime | grep -E "error|panic|kv_cache_miss"` and run evals after each stage.

ravi (oncall): Oncall alerts I'll set: 5xx increase > 0.5% over baseline OR p95 > 450ms => page. Also watch GPU OOMs and CPU > 85% sustained.

june (deploy-owner): Preflight at 17:45 PT: `./scripts/smoke_preflight.sh --env prod --tag garden-path-v2.0-canary` — alex, can you confirm image pushed by 17:30?

alex (eng-release): Image pushed and digest verified. Registry: https://gcr.company/garden-path-v2.0-canary@sha256:abcd1234 :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: I will post stage-complete + hold reminders to this thread and the #deploys channel.

sam (qa): I'll drop the eval prompt set and expected outputs in the QA doc and run the checks post-stage. Will flag any semantic regressions.

alex (eng-release): Also we should notify support/sales about cohorts being restricted (enterprise excluded). @june, can you handle the comms 10m before rollout?

june (deploy-owner): Yep — I'll post a quick note in #support 10m prior and ping account leads for enterprise.

ravi (oncall): All good from oncall side. Ping me immediately if we need to hold or rollback.

---
Notes: short holds at each stage, manual approval required to proceed. Keep the release channel open and keep everyone listed in the participants loop for the next 60m.
